message:
Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Spend",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Purchases",
    "kind": "document",
    "columns": [
     "What (text; required)",
     "Team (choice; choices: Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations, People)",
     "Requested by (person)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Supplier (text)",
     "Total (computed; worked out: the total of Amount in Purchase lines)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Ordered",
     "Received (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Purchase lines",
    "kind": "lines",
    "lines_of": "Purchases",
    "columns": [
     "Item (text; required)",
     "Quantity (number; required)",
     "Unit price (money; required)",
     "Amount (computed; worked out: Quantity × Unit price)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Expenses",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "What for (text; required)",
     "Who (person; required)",
     "Date (date; required)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; choices: Meals, Travel, Software, Cloud, Office, Other)",
     "Paid with (choice; choices: My own card, Company card)",
     "Receipt (file)",
     "Paid on (date)",
     "Note (text)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Needs a receipt (start)",
     "Submitted",
     "Approved",
     "Paid (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Finance: every row",
   "Requesters: their own rows",
   "Purchase approvers: every row"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "An expense added with its receipt is Submitted.",
   "When a receipt is attached to an expense that needs one, it is Submitted.",
   "Submitted expenses wait on Lena to approve them.",
   "An expense without a category: an AI step suggests one, Lena confirms."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. Every month on the 1st, add an expense: What for "Office rent", Who wade@fernwood.dev, Date today, Amount $2,400, Category Office, Paid with Company card.
